items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Leonard Phillips) is narrating stories told by Lester Young ('he told Red Allen', 'he used to talk about Red Allen'). There is no direct interaction or personal relationship described between Leonard Phillips and Red Allen.

ctx.x: Tell me about that. And anything he would have told Lester as a leader to his sidemen.
Yeah, he told Red Allen, in Nashville, Tennessee.
He's not that alto player who was in the picture of the band with Charlie Rouse, was he?

Oh no, not him. He was way ahead of them. Curtis was. He was way ahead of John then. See, John was coming in way behind me; I mean, the guys that I was playing with. Let me see who else was in that band. Another trumpet player named Chops.
Are you talking about John's little band?
